title: Time reversal symmetry and collapse models
version: arXiv:1502.06830v1, 24 February 2015, 26 pages; pages 1-5, 9, 11, 13-26 read through a page extraction
locator: Abstract; Sec. I (conjecture, flash ontology); Sec. II B (reverse-time test on the lattice); Sec. III (QMUPL); Sec. IV (equilibrium and boundary conditions, eqs. 44-53); Sec. V
assumptions: Collapse models with the collapse locations as the ontology; Born-rule collapses; the wave function treated as part of the law.
conclusion: Authors' claims: collapse models can be run backward with the same rule on the same collapse data; time-independent transition rules in both directions require equilibrium; observed asymmetries, including energy increase, come from asymmetric boundary conditions.
proof_status: Conjecture supported by simulations and by an argument for stochastic processes in general. No general theorem.
dependencies: Dowker-Henson and Dowker-Herbauts lattice model; Diosi QMUPL: not read.
relevance: Prior statement of the thesis of section 1; Proposition 1 is an exact finite-dimensional case.
open_questions: A general proof of their conjecture.
